verdict.rationale: Linear's own GitHub integration is documented to "sync issues" (linear-docs-80), and the changelog refers to "GitHub-synced" issues that can be opened in GitHub (linear-docs-58). This confirms first-party issue sync with a code repository's tracker, but neither item says the sync runs in both directions or explains how fields, comments or statuses stay matched. missing for 10: explicit documentation of two-way sync, field/status/comment mapping details, issue-sync support for repository trackers beyond GitHub (the GitLab item only covers merge requests), hands-on or independent corroboration.
